raw.name: Ankle impingement protection guidance
raw.notes: Reduce provoking impact, hill running, deep loaded ankle bending and forceful tiptoe work. Pace ordinary walking and use individually advised supportive footwear. The app does not distinguish front from back ankle impingement, so do not force either end of ankle range or use band traction to clear a pinch. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the movement. Seek assessment for catching, locking, loss of function, altered sensation, a hot swollen joint or fever.

raw.name: Supported comfortable ankle movement
raw.notes: Sit with the affected lower leg supported and the foot free to move. Slowly move the ankle a small amount upwards and downwards around a comfortable middle range. Do not force pointing the toes, deep upward bending, a loaded knee-over-toe lunge or a stretch into a pinch. Keep the movement unweighted and controlled; follow any clinician-directed movement restriction. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the movement. Seek assessment for catching, locking, loss of function, altered sensation, a hot swollen joint or fever.

raw.evidence_notes: OUH NHS ankle-sprain guidance supports seated heel raises with feet flat and slow lowering. Bexley NHS ankle-sprain guidance provides 10 repetitions in a comfortable range. One set, maximum once daily, no added resistance and mild clinician-described uncomplicated lateral presentation are conservative product limits, not validated LOAD thresholds or injury grades. This seated strengthening option does not certify standing weight-bearing tolerance, ROM, strength, stability or sport readiness. Existing RESTORE includes standing tasks; LOAD here is a bounded permission stage, not a claim this movement imposes greater force than every RESTORE task. raw.name: Seated controlled ankle heel raises

regress_when: Symptoms worsen: stop loading and follow conservative guidance.
stop_when: Stop for pain or worsening during or delayed symptoms. Follow clinician restrictions.

raw.name: Biceps contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised front of the upper arm from contact, heavy pulling and repeated resisted elbow bending. Support the arm comfortably at rest and follow individual movement/support restrictions. Avoid direct massage or percussion, forceful stretching and faster arm swings to test tolerance. A muscle bruise label does not exclude deeper muscle or tendon injury; automatic resistance or stretching is not prescribed. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Biceps strain recovery support
raw.notes: Protect the strained area and avoid activity that aggravates it. During the first 2 to 3 days, rest from exercise that loads it. Use comfortable everyday movement without forcing a stretch. Avoid massage and heat in the early period. Seek assessment for severe or worsening pain, swelling or inability to use the area.

raw.notes: Once pain begins to settle, support the affected elbow with your other hand. Slowly bend and straighten the elbow within a comfortable pain-free range. raw.name: Biceps tendon load-management guidance
raw.notes: Reduce activities that aggravate the affected tendon and keep the area comfortably supported. Avoid heavy lifting, strong gripping or twisting that worsens symptoms; do not repeatedly test the painful tendon. Keep ordinary comfortable movement as symptoms allow rather than applying a universal prolonged-rest timetable. Follow any clinician-directed restrictions. Sudden severe pain, a snap or pop with loss of function, suspected rupture, a hot red swollen area, fever or altered sensation needs medical assessment. Reduce provocative overhead work and end-range loading; do not force the arm behind the body.

raw.name: Comfortable unloaded elbow movement
raw.notes: Sit with the upper arm relaxed by your side and the hand empty. Slowly bend and straighten the affected elbow through a small comfortable range, stopping short of pain. Do not press on a wall, lean on the bruise, force straightening or add resistance. Follow any clinician movement restriction; this is movement only, not pushing or contact preparation. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Elbow contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised elbow from contact, leaning on the injured area, heavy carrying and forceful pressing. Support the arm comfortably without pressure on the bruise and follow any individual sling or movement restriction. Do not apply a massage gun or push the elbow against a wall to build contact tolerance. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. raw.name: Elbow hyperextension protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the elbow from repeat over-straightening. Pause pressing, throwing, forceful lockout and resisted elbow work. Support the arm comfortably at rest and follow any individually prescribed sling or movement restriction. Do not test stability, push into full extension or begin wall presses. The hospital movement advice assumes an assessed soft-tissue injury without broken bones; an app hyperextension label does not establish that assessment. Stop automatic rehab and seek assessment for giving way, locking, suspected instability, deformity, major swelling or loss of joint use. Seek urgent help for altered sensation, a cold or blue limb, or symptoms suggesting a fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions. If symptoms worsen, stop the provoking activity and seek assessment rather than testing the joint.

raw.name: Fingers contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised fingers from catching impacts, punching, heavy grip and direct pressure. Rest the hand comfortably supported and follow any prescribed finger protection or movement restriction. Do not tap the fingers on a pad, grip a cold ball or roll the injured tissue to test contact tolerance. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Forearm contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised forearm from contact, heavy grip work and resisted wrist movement. Support the arm comfortably without pressing on the bruise and follow any prescribed support or movement restriction. Do not roll a ball over the injured tissue or use a band as a recovery flush. Increasing tight swelling, abnormal sensation or circulation needs assessment rather than further loading. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Groin strain recovery support
raw.notes: Protect the strained area and avoid activity that aggravates it. During the first 2 to 3 days, rest from exercise that loads it. Use comfortable everyday movement without forcing a stretch. Avoid massage and heat in the early period. Seek assessment for severe or worsening pain, swelling or inability to use the area.

raw.name: Unresisted side-lying hip adduction
raw.notes: Once symptoms have settled enough for comfortable movement, lie on the affected side with the upper leg supported out of the way. Slowly lift and lower the lower leg through a small comfortable range. Keep the work pain-free and self-paced. Stop if groin pain increases during or after the work. Do not add ankle weights, cables, fast repetitions or fatigue work.

Unknown load remains unknown when external weight or manual pressure is not specified.
raw.name: Standing Cable Adduction

raw.name: Hand contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised hand from heavy gripping, carrying, punching and direct pressure. Rest it comfortably supported and follow any individually prescribed hand protection. Do not use contrast heat, ball pressure or a resisted grip squeeze as automatic treatment. New loss of movement or grip, excessive or increasing swelling, or altered sensation needs assessment. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Heel contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised heel from repeated hard landings, running and direct pressure. Rest the foot comfortably supported and reduce provoking standing or walking. Follow any clinician-advised footwear, heel support or weight-bearing restriction. Do not tap or roll the bruised heel to desensitize it, start barefoot loading or assume that heel tenderness rules out a bone injury. The app does not distinguish heel-pad from deeper heel injury, so automatic exercises remain unavailable. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Supported small-range hip rotation
raw.notes: Lie on your back with the affected knee comfortably bent and the foot resting on the surface. raw.name: Hip pain activity guidance
raw.notes: Reduce provoking hip activity and heavy carrying. Keep comfortable ordinary movement without overdoing it; avoid forcing end-range stretches. Follow clinician restrictions. Stop if activity makes symptoms worse or causes new symptoms. Seek assessment for persistent or worsening symptoms or reduced everyday function. Get urgent help for major trauma, deformity, inability to use or bear weight, marked or increasing swelling, a hot/red joint, fever or feeling unwell, locking/giving way, altered sensation, progressive weakness or circulation changes. raw.name: Neck soreness activity guidance

Get urgent help for major trauma, deformity, inability to use or bear weight, marked or increasing swelling, a hot/red joint, fever or feeling unwell, locking/giving way, altered sensation, progressive weakness or circulation changes. This guidance does not identify the cause, establish healing or provide contact clearance.

raw.name: Quads contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised thigh from further blows, deep squatting, kicking and provoking knee loading. Rest the leg comfortably supported and follow any clinician-prescribed position, wrap, walking support or movement restriction. Do not massage, use a percussion gun, force a thigh stretch or deepen a wall sit. Do not set or remove a bent-knee brace yourself; the extent of the contusion and safe knee movement need individual assessment. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Shoulder hyperextension protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the shoulder from repeat backward overstretching. Pause provoking reaching behind the body, bottom-range pressing, heavy lifting and contact work. Support the arm comfortably at rest and follow any individually prescribed sling or movement restriction without changing it. Do not test shoulder stability, force range or introduce band presses. Movement rehabilitation needs the assessed injury and individual restrictions; this guidance does not establish that the joint is stable. Stop automatic rehab and seek assessment for giving way, locking, suspected instability, deformity, major swelling or loss of joint use. raw.name: Toe hyperextension protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the affected toe from being bent backwards again. Pause provoking push-off, tiptoe work, running and jumping. Rest the foot in a comfortable supported position. Follow any individually prescribed footwear, walking support or weight-bearing restriction without changing it. The affected toe, joint stability and injury grade need assessment before toe curls, stretching or loaded forefoot work; this guidance does not diagnose turf toe. Stop automatic rehab and seek assessment for giving way, locking, suspected instability, deformity, major swelling or loss of joint use. Seek urgent help for altered sensation, a cold or blue limb, or symptoms suggesting a fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions. If symptoms worsen, stop the provoking activity and seek assessment rather than testing the joint.

raw.name: Triceps contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised back of the upper arm from contact, heavy pressing and resisted elbow straightening. Support the arm comfortably at rest and follow individual movement/support restrictions. Do not apply vibration balls, force an overhead stretch or increase arm-circle range to test recovery. Automatic stretching or resistance work needs an assessed injury and is not prescribed here. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Wrist contusion protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the bruised wrist from contact, heavy grip, pushing through the hand and repeated provoking wrist loading. Rest the forearm and hand comfortably supported and follow prescribed splint or movement restrictions. Do not roll or tap the bruise, add glove impact or remove protection because its colour fades. Stop if symptoms worsen during or after the activity. Seek assessment for increasing or excessive swelling, an expanding lump or hematoma, inability to use or bear weight on the limb, or major loss of function. Seek urgent help for severe pain with tense swelling, compartment syndrome concern, altered sensation, a cold limb or circulation changes, an open wound, or suspected fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions; CALM or RESTORE is not return-to-contact clearance.

raw.name: Wrist hyperextension protection guidance
raw.notes: Protect the wrist from being bent backwards again and from weight through the palm or knuckles. Pause pushing, loaded wrist extension and heavy grip work. Rest the forearm and hand comfortably supported. Follow any individually prescribed splint and movement restriction; do not remove or taper protection because symptoms improve. Assessment of the injured wrist and its stability is needed before stretching, push-ups or resistance work. Stop automatic rehab and seek assessment for giving way, locking, suspected instability, deformity, major swelling or loss of joint use. Seek urgent help for altered sensation, a cold or blue limb, or symptoms suggesting a fracture, dislocation or tear. Follow clinician restrictions. If symptoms worsen, stop the provoking activity and seek assessment rather than testing the joint.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives realistic positional resistance; use Thai pads as listed for controlled knees.
raw.name: Posture-Control Knee Flow
raw.notes: Establish useful clinch control against light resistance, create one valid opening, land one controlled knee to Thai pads, restore stance and posture, then regain position before scoring again.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives realistic positional resistance; use Thai pads as listed for controlled knees.
raw.name: Clinch Decision Rounds
raw.notes: Partner increases positional resistance and feeds frames, turns, posture battles, knee threats and brief separations at a high but controlled rate. Maintain decision quality: pummel, frame, re-posture, turn, off-balance, reconnect or score one controlled knee to Thai pads, then restore useful position before solving the next problem.

raw.equipment_note: Anchor bands to dummy for resistance
raw.name: Mat Shark
raw.notes: Drill 3-step sub chains from guard. (85% effort)

raw.equipment_note: Use Thai pads and controlled MMA feeds. Keep the pace low enough for accurate decisions.
raw.name: MMA Brawler Decision Rounds
raw.notes: The partner unpredictably presents a short striking exchange, level change, genuine committed shot, brief tie-up, or disengagement. Choose whether to continue the exchange, defend, frame, create safe separation, strike on the break, reset, or re-engage. Restore stance and base after each action; responses are not pre-called.

raw.name: Movement Economy Rounds
raw.notes: Maintain preferred range while adding a light score and reposition every 6-10 seconds. Use the fewest useful steps; no excessive bouncing, crossed feet or repeated straight retreat. Lower the pace if stance or distance control fades.

raw.equipment_note: The partner supplies light inward pressure and allows a clean technical separation.
raw.name: Frame-Separate-Reset Flow
raw.notes: From light partner connection, establish an appropriate forearm frame, create legal space, separate cleanly, and restore guard and boxing stance immediately. Reset only after balance and readiness return. Do not push the partner across the ring or hold statically.

entries.name: Inside Decision Rounds — Kickboxing / Muay Thai

raw.equipment_note: Partner controls all feeds and holds Thai pads; knees are controlled with no live impact.
raw.name: Inside Decision Rounds — Kickboxing / Muay Thai
raw.notes: Partner unpredictably presents a short punch attack, low- or body-kick cue, brief close-range entry, or cover opening. Read the exchange; cover, check, catch, or parry as appropriate; answer compactly with punches or a kick, then recoil and restore stance and guard before resetting or re-engaging. Use a controlled Thai-pad knee only on a valid close-range opening.

raw.name: Cage Wrestle Chaos
raw.notes: Partner initiates cage clinch – you must reverse or escape. (Fight pace)

raw.name: Wrestler's Wall-Walk Drill
raw.notes: From butt-scoot position, walk up wall to standing.

raw.name: Intercept-Reposition Rounds
raw.notes: The partner repeatedly enters from striking or shot range. Intercept when safe, take an angle and recover open space before the next entry. Do not admire the score. Reduce output if exits become straight or late.

raw.equipment_note: The partner wears mitts, keeps the opening action controlled, and presents targets only after legal space appears.
raw.name: Smother-Return Burst
raw.notes: The holder gives one controlled short punching action. Smother its punching space, establish brief arm or forearm control, separate into legal punching space, land one or two short punches to the mitts, then reset stance and guard. Stop if control is skipped or live head contact develops.

raw.name: Loop Choke Loop
raw.notes: Partner resists initial grip. (80% speed)

raw.name: Range Reset Flow
raw.notes: The partner changes distance with controlled forward or lateral pressure. Restore preferred range with one short retreat and an angle when needed; do not retreat straight back on consecutive actions. Recover stance before the next cue.

raw.name: Takedown-to-Knee Drill
raw.notes: Double-leg takedown into standing knee strike. Reset.

raw.name: Front Headlock Escapes
raw.notes: Partner starts in tight front headlock. (90% effort)

raw.equipment_note: Use a grappler dummy or fixed pad target. Do not chase position or use uncontrolled elbows or hammerfists.
raw.name: Ground-and-Pound Position Burst
raw.notes: Start from an already-secured mount, half-guard top, or stable postured guard-top position. Maintain base and posture through a compact 3–5 second punch or padded-strike burst. Regain stable posture and base, then fully reset. Stop when output compromises position.

raw.name: Grappler's Standup Chain
raw.notes: From bottom, stand up and immediately sprawl.

raw.name: Bicep Slicer Drill
raw.notes: Bands simulate opponent pulling arm free. (Slow burn)

raw.name: Kick Recoil Flow
raw.notes: Use controlled low or body kicks. Recoil cleanly, regain balance and restore stance before repeating; never rush volume. Reduce or stop output if recoil, support-leg balance, accuracy or stance quality deteriorates.

raw.equipment_note: Set the bag so punches and kicks land without reaching or chasing.
raw.name: Pocket Punch-Kick Cluster
raw.notes: Throw a short, compact punch combination in the pocket, then an immediate low or body kick. Recoil the kicking leg and restore stance and guard. Stop if kick recoil, stance recovery, or guard slows.

raw.name: Defend-Counter-Exit Intervals
raw.notes: Partner gives controlled single attacks. Defend, counter with one to three punches, angle out, and reset before the next cue. The athlete cannot initiate freely.

raw.equipment_note: Partner uses controlled feeds and presents pads for realistic returns.
raw.name: Defend-Counter-Reposition Intervals — Kickboxing
raw.notes: Partner mixes straight-punch, low-kick, body-kick and forward-entry cues. Read and defend, evade or intercept, make a short immediate counter of no more than two strikes, then move laterally and recover stance, guard and range. The next feed waits for the reset.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives one safe low-kick feed per effort and holds for the return.
raw.name: Check-Return Kick Burst
raw.notes: Partner gives one low-kick cue. Read and check it, fire one explosive immediate return kick, recoil quickly, and recover stance and guard inside the effort. Stop if timing, balance, recoil or defensive shape drops.

raw.name: Teep Range Reset
raw.notes: Use a basic teep to control range. Retract cleanly, restore stance and regain long range before repeating. Reduce output if recoil, balance or stance quality deteriorates.

raw.equipment_note: Hold the mitts at realistic close-range body and head positions.
raw.name: Body-Head Power Burst
raw.notes: The holder presents the open body or head target. Switch levels with 2-4 compact hooks, uppercuts, or short straights, then regain guard and stance. Stop if mechanics deteriorate.

raw.name: Long-Range MMA Decision Rounds
raw.notes: Use a marked boundary. The partner mixes passive movement, striking pressure, level changes and boundary cuts. Choose long strikes, patient range holds, angles or shot defence without automatic sprawls. Reduce output if decisions become guessed or cage awareness fades.

raw.equipment_note: The partner gives controlled arm-position resistance without changing levels or attempting a takedown.
raw.name: Tie-Up Position Burst
raw.notes: Begin at first contact. Explosively gain useful inside arm position against controlled resistance, stabilise posture and balance briefly, then release and reset in stance. Stop the rep if it becomes a body lock, throw, or wrestling exchange.

raw.name: Fence Escape Denial
raw.notes: The partner attempts left and right fence escapes. Deny the route with feet and position before scoring; stop and reset if the athlete reaches, crosses feet or becomes square.

raw.name: Max Knee & Sprawl Complex
raw.notes: Builds output for finishing exchanges against the ropes/cage. Alternate between straight and diagonal knees. (95% effort)

raw.name: Limb Collector
raw.notes: Bands on wrists to simulate opponent pulling back. (Explosive extensions)

raw.equipment_note: Partner controls the pace and uses Thai pads for safe mixed-strike exchanges.
raw.name: Close-Range Exchange Rounds
raw.notes: Work partner-led short pocket exchanges at a sustainable pace. Mix compact punches with low or body kicks, recoil every kick, and restore stance, guard, and posture before a brief reset or re-engagement. Do not chase between exchanges.

raw.name: Clinch to Takedown Scramble
raw.notes: Partner resists – you must chain takedowns. (90% effort)

raw.name: Hybrid's Stance Transition Drill
raw.notes: Switch between orthodox/southpaw every 5 steps. (low-moderate)

raw.name: Pressure-Escape Distance Rounds
raw.notes: Use long guard, teep feints and lateral steps to escape pressure, then restore preferred range. Do not rely on repeated straight-line retreat.

raw.name: Submission Chain Fatigue Drill
raw.notes: Cycle through 3 submission attempts without pausing.

raw.name: Reactive Sprawl Jumps
raw.notes: Partner claps to signal sprawl. Max-height jump after.

raw.equipment_note: Partner provides active Thai clinch resistance and reduces it if technique drifts towards wrestling.
raw.name: Clinch Reposition Intervals
raw.notes: Partner contests inside position, posture, angle, turns and head or arm control. Repeatedly gain, lose or change, recover and stabilise. Reduce resistance before movement becomes wrestling.

raw.equipment_note: Use a partner and padded wall or cage simulation. No uncontrolled impact into the surface.
raw.modality: sustainable favourable and unfavourable cage positioning
raw.name: Cage Position Flow
raw.notes: Flow between being pinned to the cage and holding favourable cage control. Against light live resistance, gain inside and head position, answer underhook battles, turn attempts, escapes and brief separation, then reverse or re-establish useful standing connection. Maintain awareness of controlled MMA level-change and takedown threats while keeping the exchange standing.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives realistic positional resistance; use Thai pads as listed for controlled knees.
raw.name: Knee-and-Recover Intervals
raw.notes: Gain useful clinch against resistance, land one controlled knee to Thai pads, recover posture and feet, solve the partner’s renewed position contest, then regain control before scoring again.

raw.name: Ring-Cutting Intervals
raw.notes: The partner changes direction throughout. Cut the escape route before throwing and do not follow in a straight line; lower the pace if stance integrity is lost.

raw.name: D’Arce Depth Charge
raw.notes: Med ball simulates opponent’s head pressure. (Explosive shots)

raw.name: Cage-Push Escapes
raw.notes: Explosive push-off from pinned cage position.

raw.name: Read & Counter Flow
raw.notes: Partner gives controlled jab, rear straight, hook or forward-entry cues. Defend or intercept, return a light counter, then regain stance and range. Keep the pace easy; reduce cue variety if the athlete guesses or loses shape.

raw.name: Range Reset Intervals
raw.notes: Partner advances intermittently. Use the jab, step-slide or backstep, then reset laterally to preferred range.

raw.name: Counter Shadow Flow
raw.notes: Cycle through named imagined cues: jab, rear straight, hook and forward entry. Use the matching defence, counter at light speed, then angle out and reset. Do not free-punch between cues.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives realistic positional resistance; use Thai pads as listed for controlled knees.
raw.name: Grip-Fight-to-Score Intervals
raw.notes: Partner actively contests arm and inside position. Hand-fight to useful control, create a valid opening, score one controlled knee to Thai pads, then reset and solve the next contest. No free knee.

raw.name: Clinch Hold & Knee Complex
raw.notes: Builds plumb-position endurance while striking. Alternate between single collar and double collar ties. (90% effort)

raw.name: Pressure Combination Rounds
raw.notes: Close distance behind a safe entry, combine in the pocket, then recover stance without giving up useful pressure. Reduce output if punch quality or defensive head position collapses.

raw.name: Twister Protocol
raw.notes: Focus on grip transitions. (Slow, technical)

raw.name: Strike-to-Fence Pressure
raw.notes: Use a clean strike entry to move the partner towards the fence, connect position, then score again. Cut the lateral escape before attacking and reduce output if stance or defensive responsibility collapses.

raw.name: Long-Distance Shadowboxing
raw.notes: Emphasize footwork and jab-cross out-fighting. (low-moderate)

raw.name: Cage to Center Scramble
raw.notes: Partner pins to cage – you must escape to center. (Fight pace)

raw.name: Cage Cutting Footwork
raw.notes: Practice cutting off octagon while shadowboxing.

raw.name: Straight-Shot Re-Angle
raw.notes: Fire one explosive jab-cross or rear straight, retract cleanly, then make a 30-45 degree angle exit before resetting.

raw.equipment_note: Use controlled shots and Thai pads. The athlete must read the partner rather than pre-sprawl.
raw.modality: repeated close exchanges with live shot decisions
raw.name: Pocket Strike-Shot Intervals
raw.notes: The partner unpredictably presents a short striking exchange, a genuine committed shot, or no shot. Exchange compactly, defend only when necessary, make a brief strike return or safe separation, and restore stance and base before the next exchange.

raw.equipment_note: A padded wall may replace the cage. Use controlled glove or pad contact.
raw.modality: balanced close exchanges near the cage
raw.name: Cage Pocket Exchange Intervals
raw.notes: Start near the cage, not fixed against it. The partner gives short striking exchanges, occasional shot or brief tie-up threats, and lateral movement. Strike compactly, stay balanced, use appropriate defence, then angle or reset when position collapses and restore stance and base. The goal is scoring safely, not driving the partner backwards.

raw.name: Bilateral Round-Kick Flow
raw.notes: Kick the bag with controlled round kicks from both sides. Recoil and restore stance after every kick; do not chase volume. Reduce output if support-leg balance, accuracy or stance quality deteriorates.

raw.name: Submission Hunter's Guard Retention
raw.notes: Partner attempts passes while you maintain guard. (low-moderate)

raw.name: Cage Escape Intervals
raw.notes: Use a marked boundary. The partner repeatedly advances from open range. Escape laterally with movement, a strike or frame, then regain open space before the next exchange. Never retreat straight on consecutive exchanges. Reduce output if cage awareness drops.

raw.equipment_note: Partner holds Thai pads and waits for a complete stance reset between feeds.
raw.name: Check-Return Intervals — Kickboxing
raw.notes: Partner varies the timing and side of controlled low- and body-kick feeds. Read, check, make an immediate kick return, recoil, and recover stance and guard before every new cue. Reduce feed rate if balance, timing or defensive shape fades.

raw.equipment_note: The partner changes arm position at a sustainable pace and reduces resistance if posture or balance deteriorates.
raw.name: Inside Position Flow
raw.notes: Use light continuous partner resistance. Gain inside hand or forearm position, keep the feet underneath the body and maintain posture as the partner changes arm position. Regain useful connection, then separate under control and restore stance and guard. No takedowns, neck cranking, or extended collar ties.

raw.name: Random Attack Counter Rounds
raw.notes: Holder attacks unpredictably with jab, rear straight, hook or forward entry. Read, defend or intercept, counter, then reposition. Slow the feeds if timing or stance recovery declines.

raw.name: Kick & Exit Flow
raw.notes: Land a low or body kick, recoil, leave the return line and restore stance before repeating. Reduce output if recoil, balance, accuracy or stance quality deteriorates.

raw.name: Heel Hook Highway
raw.notes: KB on ankle to simulate opponent weight. (Max control)

raw.name: Level-Threat Pressure Reset
raw.notes: React to the partner’s level-change threat, protect stance and head position, then take back useful pressure before a short score. Stop the rep if the feet become square or balance is lost.

raw.name: Max-Power Bag Burst
raw.notes: Deliver a five-second maximal-quality burst, then recover fully. Stop the burst if punch speed, shape or head position drops.

raw.name: Reshot Chains
raw.notes: Initial shot > sprawl > immediate reshot. No pauses.

raw.name: Score-Reposition Rounds
raw.notes: Work in controlled exchanges at useful range. Every score must finish with angle or space gained and stance recovered before the next exchange. Reduce output if either athlete can no longer control distance or balance.

raw.name: Reactive Range Decision Burst
raw.notes: The partner gives one unpredictable cue: striking advance, genuine level change or no entry. Select an intercept and exit, shot defence, or patient range hold. Do not force an action. Stop if response speed or stance drops.

raw.name: Level-Change Respect Flow
raw.notes: The partner mixes normal movement with genuine level changes. Maintain range, angle off or move the hips back as needed. Only sprawl when the partner can reach the legs, then restore stance and preferred range.

raw.duration: 30s clinch knees → 30s short punches → x5 rounds
raw.equipment_note: Thai pads or heavy bag ideal
raw.name: Dutch Clinch Drill
raw.notes: Develops Dutch-style combination striking from the clinch. (90% effort)

raw.name: Pressure Fighter's Cutoff Shadow
raw.notes: Advance while cutting off angles in mirror.

raw.name: Long-Range Decision Rounds
raw.notes: Choose jab, teep or long kick from the holder’s cue, then recover stance and exit. Reduce output when decisions, recoil or range control lose quality.

raw.name: Open-Space Movement Flow
raw.notes: Move economically in MMA stance. Enter to score, then leave before an imagined wrestling connection. Keep the centre and do not drift towards the marked boundary on consecutive exchanges.

raw.name: Long-Range Movement Flow
raw.notes: Move at long range behind the jab and long guard. Keep the stance narrow enough to kick, then exit laterally; lower the pace if balance changes.

raw.name: Reactive Counter Choice
raw.notes: Holder gives one unpredictable jab, rear straight, hook or forward-entry cue. Select the correct defence or intercept, counter immediately, then reposition. Reduce cue choices if the athlete starts guessing.

raw.equipment_note: Angle bag to simulate opponent lean.
raw.name: Corner Knee Bursts
raw.notes: Max-power knees to trapped bag. Full hip extension.

raw.name: Guard Recovery Sprint
raw.notes: Partner starts in side control. (90% speed)

raw.name: Pocket Repeatability Rounds
raw.notes: Repeat short-range combinations with brief stance resets inside each work bout. Reduce output if punch shape, head position or balance collapses.

raw.name: Range-Adaptive Kick Rounds
raw.notes: The holder changes distance without inviting pursuit. Maintain a credible kick-led threat, select a kick suited to the available range, recoil and regain useful position. Reduce feed density if recoil, balance, accuracy or stance recovery deteriorates.

raw.name: Ring Perimeter Flow
raw.notes: Circle in stance at a relaxed pace. Every 8-12 seconds, jab or feint, make an angle exit, then restore preferred range.

raw.name: Guillotine Gauntlet
raw.notes: Sandbag mimics sprawl pressure. (80% squeeze)

raw.name: Jab-to-Pressure Flow
raw.notes: Use the jab to enter, take a useful forward position and reset stance after each entry. No clear target means no forced attack; circle out and rebuild.

raw.modality: bilateral MMA kicking and stance recovery
raw.name: Bilateral MMA Kick Flow
raw.notes: Build credible low and body kicks from both stances without chasing switch-kick volume. Recoil and restore a defensively useful stance after each kick; reduce output if either side becomes square or unstable.

raw.name: Pummeling Endurance Rounds
raw.notes: Hand-fighting only. No takedowns.

raw.name: Ezekiel Finishing Drill
raw.notes: Focus on forearm pressure. (90% squeeze)

raw.name: Backstep Counter Reset
raw.notes: On the advance cue, make a controlled backstep, fire a straight counter, then exit laterally and restore range.

raw.equipment_note: The holder varies controlled hooks, short straights, and body attacks.
raw.name: Guard-and-Answer Intervals
raw.notes: Respond to each controlled short-range attack with a cover, roll, or catch, then answer immediately and regain the high guard. Wait for the next cue; do not free-hit continuously. Reduce output if defence or stance deteriorates.

raw.name: Strike-Shot Transition Flow
raw.notes: Partner alternates unpredictably between a controlled striking attack and a level-change or shot cue. Athlete reads which threat is present, uses striking defence or appropriate hip and takedown defence, makes one light counter to the pads after safe separation, then recovers stance and range. Keep shot feeds submaximal; this is not a repeated-sprawl circuit.

raw.name: North-South Chokehold
raw.notes: Sandbag on chest mimics opponent bridging. (85% effort)

raw.equipment_note: Partner uses Thai pads for the controlled straight cue and the safe teep or counter target.
raw.name: Intercept & Counter Mitts
raw.notes: Holder gives either a forward-entry cue or a long straight cue. Read the action: teep the entry, or parry the straight and return a straight punch or kick. Make one explosive response, then recoil and recover stance, guard and range. The holder chooses the cue, not the athlete.

raw.name: Rope/Corner Pressure Rounds
raw.notes: Keep the partner contained and score from a balanced stance rather than throwing nonstop. Maintain defensive head position; stop and reset whenever the athlete becomes square.

raw.name: BJJ Explosive Guard Pull
raw.notes: Pull guard with immediate hip bump sweep attempt.

raw.name: Failed-Entry Reset Intervals
raw.notes: The partner sometimes removes the target or blocks the entry. After a miss, rebuild stance, protect the hips and exit before body contact. Do not chase the failed score. Reduce output if recovery needs more than one step.

raw.name: Pressure Reset Intervals
raw.notes: Shadow a safe entry and attack, recover stance, then rebuild pressure immediately. No opportunity means no forced attack; stop and reset if the feet become square.

raw.name: Stuff-Shot Counter Exit
raw.notes: Partner gives one controlled takedown-entry cue. Athlete reads and stuffs or otherwise defends the entry, establishes safe separation, lands one short counter to the pad, exits laterally into open space, then resets completely. End the effort if it becomes prolonged wrestling or stance recovery slows.

raw.name: Rear-Kick Power Singles
raw.notes: Throw one maximum-quality rear body or low kick. Recoil fully and restore a balanced defensive stance before resting.

raw.name: Sprawl-to-Takedown Reaction Drill
raw.notes: Partner signals shot randomly. React with sprawl then immediate takedown.

raw.name: Low-Kick Repeatability
raw.notes: Repeat realistic low or calf-kick opportunities and restore an MMA stance after each kick. Reduce or stop output if recoil slows, support-leg balance or accuracy drops, the stance becomes square, or it cannot handle an entry threat.

raw.name: Gogoplata Grinder
raw.notes: Emphasize hamstring flexibility. (Slow, controlled)

raw.name: Kick-Step Pressure Rounds
raw.notes: Link kicks to balanced step-down pressure and short punch combinations. Regain stance after every kick and reduce output if recoil, posture or target quality collapses.

raw.equipment_note: Set the bag so compact punches land without reaching.
raw.name: Pocket Power Cluster
raw.notes: Throw 3-4 compact hooks or uppercuts in the pocket. Restore the high guard and stance immediately. Stop if punch mechanics, stance, or guard recovery deteriorate.

raw.name: Lateral Escape Burst
raw.notes: The partner advances from just outside scoring range. Make one short lateral or angled escape, recover stance and face the partner at usable range. Do not turn it into a long retreat. Stop and reset if speed, balance or position deteriorates.

raw.equipment_note: Partner contact stays controlled so technical quality is maintained.
raw.name: Pocket Exchange Rounds
raw.notes: Use controlled short pocket exchanges with body-head variation, a high guard, and stable head position. Briefly reset between exchanges. Keep a sustainable pace and do not chase across the ring.

raw.name: Kick-to-Pressure Flow
raw.notes: Kick at a controlled pace, step down in stance and take useful forward position before the next attack. Do not fall square or force a follow-up when balance is poor.

raw.name: Sprawl to Spin Drill
raw.notes: Bands on hips to resist sprawl recovery. (Max speed)

raw.equipment_note: Use a partner and padded wall or cage simulation. Keep the turn controlled with no uncontrolled wall impact.
raw.name: Cage Turn Burst
raw.notes: Start in an unfavourable cage relationship. Establish useful inside and head position, turn the partner to reverse the position, gain favourable cage control and stabilise before resetting. Do not slam or throw. Stabilise standing control without converting the turn into takedown completion.

raw.name: Shadow Flow Rounds
raw.notes: Emphasize footwork pivots and defensive slips between combos (60-70% effort)

raw.name: Defensive Position Flow
raw.notes: Use a fixed cue sequence: jab to slip, straight to parry, hook to roll. Add one light counter after each defence, then recover stance and range before the next cue.

raw.equipment_note: The holder creates a brief separation and a realistic re-entry opening.
raw.name: Exchange-Reentry Burst
raw.notes: Complete a short pocket exchange, take a half-step reset, then use the holder's opening to re-enter with a compact combination. Recover stance. Do not chase at long range.

raw.name: Band-Resisted Whizzer & Sprawl Complex
raw.notes: Develops late-round takedown defense from overhook positions. (90% effort)

raw.equipment_note: Partner limits the menu to safe, controlled kicks and allows a full reset.
raw.name: Kick Defence Reset Flow
raw.notes: Partner mixes controlled low-kick and body-kick cues. Read each feed, check, forearm-parry or step just outside range as appropriate, make one light kick return, recoil, then recover stance and defensive position. Do not preselect the defence.

raw.name: Guard Pass to Backtake
raw.notes: If pass is blocked, transition to back. (Technical speed)

raw.name: Target-Choice Kick Rounds
raw.notes: The holder presents a meaningful low, body or high pad target. Read it, select the appropriate kick, recoil and restore stance. Reduce feed density if recoil slows, support-leg balance or accuracy deteriorates, the athlete becomes square, or stance cannot be restored.

raw.name: Level-Change Uppercut Burst
raw.notes: Holder gives a controlled level-change cue and presents a mitt target. Athlete reads the cue, uses the uppercut as a specific interception option, fires once to the mitt, exits off line, then recovers stance and guard. This is not a universal takedown response; stop if the athlete guesses or loses defensive shape.

raw.equipment_note: Keep each tie-up brief and controlled. Use Thai pads for clean strike targets.
raw.modality: close striking with brief tie-up interruptions
raw.name: Frame-Break-Reengage Intervals
raw.notes: Work through repeated short-range striking exchanges. The partner occasionally adds a brief tie-up. Frame for safe separation, score with a short immediate strike sequence, restore stance and base, then read the next exchange. Stop and redesign if hand fighting occupies most of the interval.

raw.equipment_note: Partner holds Thai pads, controls the knee entry, and avoids live impact.
raw.name: Pocket Knee Reentry Burst
raw.notes: Complete a short exchange, use a brief frame and separation, then take a valid Thai-pad knee opening and add one compact punch. Restore stance and guard immediately; release immediately after the knee. Stop if posture or stance recovery slows.

raw.name: Ring-Cut Flow
raw.notes: Repeat left and right cutoff patterns at an easy technical pace. Step across the escape route before advancing; never cross the feet or become square.

raw.name: Long-Weapon Exit Flow
raw.notes: The holder advances lightly. Score with a jab, teep or long kick, recover stance, and exit laterally rather than retreating straight back. Lower the pace if the exit becomes a straight retreat.

raw.name: Octagon Footwork Gauntlet
raw.notes: Touch all 8 cage sections in sequence.

raw.name: Teep Walk-Down Reset
raw.notes: Land a sharp teep, step forward under control and score a short follow-up before resetting. Stop the rep if the kicking leg drops out of stance or the athlete chases square.

raw.equipment_note: Use wrestler mat for knee protection.
raw.name: Sprawl-to-Strike Intervals
raw.notes: Sprawl, then spring up into 2 knees + 2 elbows.

raw.name: Low-Kick Re-Catch Intervals
raw.notes: Low kick, read the partner’s escape and cut the route before scoring again. Do not follow straight behind; stop and reset if kick recoil or stance recovery breaks down.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives realistic positional resistance; use Thai pads as listed for controlled knees.
raw.name: Reactive Clinch Position Rounds
raw.notes: Partner unpredictably changes grips, frames, straightens, turns, separates or presents a knee opening. Choose to pummel, frame, re-posture, turn, reconnect, score one controlled knee or stabilise; no pre-called response.

raw.name: Grappler's Flow Roll
raw.notes: No submissions - constant positional transitions.

raw.equipment_note: Partner presents a body pad and varies the timing of controlled forward entries.
raw.name: Teep Intercept Flow
raw.notes: Partner gives a clear forward-entry cue. Read the step, intercept with a light teep, recoil the kicking leg, replace the foot, recover stance, guard and range, then accept the next feed.

raw.name: Range Recovery Intervals
raw.notes: Start from a compressed distance cue. Restore preferred range, score once, reposition, then repeat at a demanding pace. Do not retreat straight back on consecutive actions. Reduce output if stance or balance breaks down.

raw.equipment_note: Use Thai pads and controlled contact. Reduce pace before reading or stance quality falls.
raw.name: MMA Close-Exchange Flow
raw.notes: At a sustainable pace, the partner mixes short striking exchanges, genuine level-change threats, brief tie-ups, separation and disengagement. Read each threat, use appropriate defence, continue scoring or disengage, and restore stance and base. Decision quality must stay clear.

raw.equipment_note: Partner provides controlled positional resistance. Release safely on the reset.
raw.name: Underhook Position Burst
raw.notes: From standing connection, explosively win a useful underhook and head position against controlled resistance, stabilise posture and balance, then reset. Success is secure standing position, not takedown completion.

raw.name: Takedown Shot Reaction Drill
raw.notes: Partner points direction; shooter explodes that way.

raw.name: Electric Chair Sweep
raw.notes: KB on hip to add resistance. (Explosive hips)

raw.name: Intercept-and-Exit Burst
raw.notes: The partner enters aggressively from shot range. Intercept with one appropriate long strike and angle out before body contact. Stop the set if reaction speed, stance or defensive shape drops.

raw.equipment_note: Use a wall as the practical cage substitute; partner controls pressure and presents safe pad targets.
raw.name: Cage Counter Movement Flow
raw.notes: Partner applies controlled forward pressure toward a wall or cage. Athlete reads the pressure, defends or frames, angles away, makes one light counter to the pads, regains open space, then resets in stance. Position restored is the success condition; lower pressure if footwork or defensive shape breaks down.

raw.equipment_note: Partner uses controlled contact and Thai pads for the selected return.
raw.name: Reactive Counter Choice — Kickboxing
raw.notes: Partner unpredictably chooses jab, rear straight, low kick or forward entry. Perceive the attack, select a suitable defence or interception, make one immediate punch, kick or teep counter, then recoil and recover stance and defensive position. Do not reveal the answer before the cue; stop if guessing begins.

raw.name: Cage-Space Kick Rounds
raw.notes: Use an open-space lane with one edge marked as the limited-space boundary. The partner varies usable kick space, compressed range, forward pressure and lateral escape. Choose to kick, reposition, frame or reset without pursuing or wall wrestling. Reduce output if stance or decisions fade.

raw.equipment_note: Use a partner, Thai pad and padded wall or cage simulation. Control all contact and wall pressure; no live knees or elbows to the head.
raw.modality: high-density MMA clinch decisions under fatigue
raw.name: MMA Clinch Decision Rounds
raw.notes: Under higher live resistance, the partner unpredictably creates an underhook battle, cage pin or reversal, frame, level change, separation, short-strike opening, circle-away or takedown-entry opportunity. Choose to pummel, frame, gain head and inside position, defend the level change, turn, separate, make one controlled pad strike, establish an entry position or reconnect. Preserve decisions under fatigue and recover standing control; do not finish takedowns.

raw.name: Long Combination Rounds
raw.notes: Build long combinations from jab or long guard and finish with an angled exit. Lower the pace if balance or clean target selection fades.

raw.equipment_note: Use Thai pads for the return. Agree controlled shot intensity and a safe mat area.
raw.modality: close exchange with live takedown decision
raw.name: Exchange-Sprawl-Return Burst
raw.notes: Begin a short striking exchange. The partner may make a genuine committed shot. Read the attack, use appropriate takedown defence only when needed, create safe separation, return 1–2 compact strikes, and restore stance and base.

raw.name: Strike-Sprawl-Reset Burst
raw.notes: Score once. The partner may strike, level-change or stay out. Only sprawl when a genuine shot reaches the legs; otherwise use range, angle or hip-back readiness. Reset stance and range. Stop if the cue is read late.

raw.name: Kick-or-Defend Decision Rounds
raw.notes: The partner presents a kickable target and range, a punching entry or a controlled level-change threat. Choose to kick, reposition or defend; not kicking is a correct repetition. Reduce output if stance recovery, accuracy or threat recognition fades.

raw.name: Cage Cut & Re-Catch
raw.notes: Guide the partner towards the fence at a controlled pace, deny the open-side exit and re-catch each direction change. Do not chase straight behind or cross the feet; reset stance before continuing.

raw.name: Kneebar Khaos
raw.notes: Bands on ankles to simulate opponent retracting leg. (Explosive hips)

raw.name: Grappler's Blindfold Pummeling
raw.notes: Forces reliance on grip/body feel over sight (30% effort)

raw.equipment_note: The partner varies arm position and gives moderate continuous resistance without takedown attempts.
raw.name: Inside Position Intervals
raw.notes: Contest inside hand position, forearm control, posture and balance repeatedly. Keep the feet underneath the body, the head stable and guard responsibility intact while regaining useful connection. Separate cleanly and restore guard at the end of each interval. Reduce resistance if either boxer starts wrestling or holding statically.

raw.name: Escape-Recatch Burst
raw.notes: The partner escapes left or right; reposition immediately and re-establish pressure before scoring. Cut the route rather than following, then reset fully.

raw.name: Low-Kick Exit Burst
raw.notes: Land one hard low kick, recover the leg, restore stance and exit the opponent’s return line. Keep the hips under the body and do not over-rotate.

raw.name: Reactive Distance Rounds
raw.notes: The partner unpredictably enters, holds or gives ground. Choose whether to enter, hold range, intercept or exit, then recover stance and preferred range before the next cue. Reduce output if decisions become automatic or position breaks down.

raw.name: Peruvian Necktie Drill
raw.notes: Bands on dummy’s shoulders for resistance. (Fast setups)

raw.duration: 3min rounds: arm trap → choke, 1min rest x 4
raw.name: Crucifix Collector
raw.notes: Partner tries to bench press escape. (85% control)

raw.equipment_note: The holder varies realistic close-range cues without calling a fixed response.
raw.name: Inside Decision Rounds
raw.notes: Read unpredictable controlled short-range attacks, cover opportunities, or brief disengagements. Choose to cover, roll, catch, answer body or head, reset, or re-engage. Do not preselect the response; lower the pace if decisions or guard deteriorate.

raw.name: Fence-Escape Burst
raw.notes: Begin one step from a marked boundary, not pinned to it. As the partner closes, use a strike, frame or angle and regain open space laterally. Reset if body contact becomes established. Stop when stance or defensive shape drops.

raw.equipment_note: The partner holds Thai pads and stays close enough for clean strikes without chasing.
raw.name: MMA Pocket Power Cluster
raw.notes: Exchange at close range, then deliver a compact 2–4 strike burst. Restore stance with hips underneath, balanced posture and hands ready for an appropriate takedown defence. Stop if the athlete becomes square, reaches, or cannot remain shot-ready.

raw.name: Hybrid's Transition Circuit
raw.notes: Alternate between striking and shot feints.

raw.equipment_note: Partner actively contests position and presents a Thai pad when appropriate. Keep strikes and entry positions controlled.
raw.name: Pummel-to-Attack Intervals
raw.notes: Pummel against active resistance and first win useful underhook, head or cage position. Then choose one suitable action: one short controlled pad strike, a cage turn, or a controlled takedown-entry position. Reset and re-engage. Do not complete a takedown or continue into a wrestling chain.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives live positional resistance and presents a Thai pad. Use controlled pad contact; no live knees or elbows to the head.
raw.modality: short strikes conditional on standing clinch control
raw.name: Clinch Strike-Control Intervals
raw.notes: Win or maintain useful standing clinch position, take one short controlled punch or knee opportunity on the pad, and immediately recover head and arm position as the partner contests. Reposition, keep awareness of the MMA takedown threat, and strike again only when control allows. A strike that collapses connection is a poor rep.

raw.modality: MMA kick recoil and stance recovery
raw.name: MMA Kick Recoil Flow
raw.notes: Throw controlled low or body kicks, recoil cleanly and finish with the hips under the body in a stance ready for a punch or takedown threat. Reduce output if balance, recoil or stance recovery fades.

raw.name: Pull-Straight Burst
raw.notes: Holder steps in with a straight-punch cue. Pull just out of range, return one straight immediately, then recover stance and distance. Every rep starts from the entry cue.

raw.equipment_note: The partner gives controlled positional resistance and stays balanced throughout the turn.
raw.name: Turn-and-Separate Burst
raw.notes: Control the connection, use foot position and upper-body contact to turn or reposition the partner, then separate cleanly and restore stance and guard in the better boxing position. No throws, trips, or prolonged body locks.

raw.equipment_note: Partner controls contact and feed density while presenting safe pad targets.
raw.name: Random Attack Counter Rounds — Kickboxing
raw.notes: Partner unpredictably feeds a jab, rear straight, low kick, body kick or forward entry. Athlete cannot initiate: read the attack, choose a sound defence or interception, counter immediately, recoil kicks, then recover stance and defensive position with a lateral reset. Lower the feed rate when choices or shape deteriorate.

raw.name: Pressure Decision Rounds
raw.notes: The partner cues a left, right or backward escape. Select the correct cutoff, regain position, then score; no correct position means no forced attack.

raw.name: Clinch Marching Rounds
raw.notes: Maintain plum position while circling.

raw.name: Stand-Up Sprint
raw.notes: Bands around waist for resistance. (Max explosion)

raw.name: Punch-Slide Repeatability
raw.notes: Inside each work minute, perform a 5-8 second fast straight-punch burst, immediately slide or pivot away, move under control, then repeat.

raw.name: In-Out MMA Striking Rounds
raw.notes: Enter for short scoring exchanges, exit before wrestling contact and recover stance at long range. The partner may threaten a shot during either transition. Reduce output if the athlete stays extended or loses hip-back readiness.

raw.name: Reactive MMA Counter Choice
raw.notes: Partner gives one unpredictable cue from a restricted set: jab, rear straight, kick, forward pressure, level change or controlled takedown entry. Athlete reads the threat, chooses a sound defence or interception, counters immediately to the pads, then repositions and recovers stance. Reduce the cue set if guessing begins and stop when reaction quality falls.

raw.name: Buggy Choke Crucible
raw.notes: Partner starts in side control. (85% squeeze)

raw.name: Switch-Kick Repeatability
raw.notes: Repeat switch kicks from controlled movement. Reduce or stop output if switch rhythm or recoil slows, support-leg balance or accuracy deteriorates, the athlete becomes square, or stance cannot be restored.

raw.name: Strike-or-Shot Counter Intervals
raw.notes: Partner repeatedly alternates unpredictably between controlled strike and takedown-entry cues. Athlete reads each threat, uses the appropriate defence, counters briefly to the pads, recovers guard and stance, then waits for the next cue without free initiation. Lower feed density if defensive shape or decision accuracy breaks down.

raw.equipment_note: Partner wears Thai pads and feeds one controlled straight punch per effort.
raw.name: Pull-Kick Counter Burst
raw.notes: Partner cues a jab or rear straight. Read it, pull or slide just beyond the strike, make one immediate body- or low-kick return, recoil, then recover stance, guard and range. One clean response per effort; stop if the athlete guesses.

raw.name: Calf Slicer Pressure Drill
raw.notes: KB on thigh to simulate opponent’s resistance. (Slow burn)

raw.name: Scrambler's Standup Explosions
raw.notes: From bottom position, explode to feet in one motion.

raw.name: Anti-Fence Range Rounds
raw.notes: Use a marked boundary. Score while protecting open-space position. Circle before the boundary blocks the exit and refuse prolonged backward drift. Reduce output if stance, level-change awareness or boundary checks deteriorate.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives realistic positional resistance; use Thai pads as listed for controlled knees.
raw.name: Posture-Break Knee Burst
raw.notes: From connection, win safe posture control against resistance, briefly disrupt balance, land one controlled knee to Thai pads, then immediately regain a stable clinch position.

raw.name: Kick-Reposition Rounds
raw.notes: After every long kick, recoil into stance and reposition before scoring again. No stable stance means no next kick.

raw.equipment_note: Partner controls contact and presents Thai pads for each close-range answer.
raw.name: Guard-and-Low-Kick Answer
raw.notes: Partner varies controlled short punch attacks. Cover, catch, or roll as appropriate; answer with a short punch and low kick, recoil the kick, then restore stance and guard before the next cue. Win each exchange, then restore position.

raw.name: Shot to Granby Roll
raw.notes: Emphasize smooth hip movement. (85% effort)

raw.name: Toe Hold Torment
raw.notes: Bands on foot for resistance. (Fast hands)

raw.name: Range Intercept Burst
raw.notes: The partner crosses preferred range without a fixed rhythm. Intercept only when the crossing action is clear, then leave the return line and restore range. Stop and reset if timing, stance or positional control deteriorates.

raw.name: Cage-Aware Range Flow
raw.notes: Use a marked boundary. Manage the partner and boundary together. Reposition laterally rather than retreating straight on consecutive exchanges, and regain open space before starting again.

raw.name: Body-Head Pressure Intervals
raw.notes: Alternate credible body and head combinations while keeping pressure between attacks. Regain stance before each new combination and reduce output if clean target changes disappear.

raw.name: Brawler's Forward Shadow
raw.notes: Aggressive forward movement with high guard.

raw.name: Reactive Body-Kick Burst
raw.notes: The holder moves and presents an actual body target. Recognise the opportunity, kick explosively, recoil and restore stance. No target means no kick.

raw.name: Strike to Takedown Scramble
raw.notes: Coach signals shot after random strikes. (85% speed)

raw.name: Kick-Level-Change Ready Reset
raw.notes: Kick the held target, recoil and restore stance. The holder then shows either a normal striking reset or a controlled level-change threat; respond with sound defensive posture only. Do not complete a takedown.

raw.name: Body-Kick Repeatability
raw.notes: Take repeated realistic body-kick opportunities. Reduce or stop output if recoil slows, support-leg balance deteriorates, accuracy falls, or stance cannot be restored.

raw.name: Reactive Long-Weapon Burst
raw.notes: On the holder’s advance, choose jab, teep or long kick and angle away after scoring. Stop if the choice, recoil or exit loses speed.

raw.name: Jab-Kick Entry Burst
raw.notes: Enter behind a long jab, kick the called open target, regain stance, and leave on an angle. No target means no kick.

raw.equipment_note: Work close enough for compact hooks and uppercuts without leaning.
raw.name: Pocket Combination Intervals
raw.notes: Repeat compact pocket combinations with a guard reset between each. Alternate body-head patterns. Reduce output if punches become arm-dominant, the stance widens, or the guard disappears.

raw.name: Sprawl-Counter Burst
raw.notes: Partner gives one clear, committed but controlled shot cue. Athlete reads it, sprawls or uses appropriate hip defence, creates safe striking separation, lands one immediate counter to the pad, then resets completely. Stop the set when reaction speed, hip position or stance recovery declines.

raw.name: Intercepting Knee Entry Burst
raw.notes: Partner controls a committed forward or level-change cue and presents a Thai-pad target. Where technically appropriate, athlete reads the entry, intercepts the pad with one knee, recoils, then restores stance and defensive position. Never use uncontrolled live knee contact; stop if timing, balance or recoil deteriorates.

raw.name: Guillotine Shot Sprints
raw.notes: Sprint 10m, drop to guillotine grip, reset. Repeat.

raw.equipment_note: Partner feeds one controlled kick only after stance and guard are restored.
raw.name: Counter Kick Matrix
raw.notes: Partner gives controlled low- and body-kick cues. Read the kick, check, make an immediate light return kick, recoil it, then recover stance and guard before the next feed. Alternate sides without chasing pace; balance and clean position end every repetition.

raw.name: Mir Lock Madness
raw.notes: KB on wrist to simulate opponent’s defense. (Slow grind)

raw.name: Dump Explosions
raw.notes: Max-effort hip toss from clinch position.

raw.name: Scrambler's Turtle Recovery
raw.notes: From turtle, stand up and circle out repeatedly.

raw.name: Standing Backtake Drill
raw.notes: Partner defends first 3 seconds. (85% control)

raw.name: Kick-and-Exit Burst
raw.notes: Land one clean long kick, recover the kicking leg into stance, and exit laterally. Stop the set if speed or stance recovery deteriorates.

raw.name: Precision Under Pace
raw.notes: Maintain straight-shot accuracy with movement between exchanges. Speed may reduce slightly, but stance, accuracy and defensive recovery must stay clean.

raw.modality: linear kick entry control and frame
raw.name: Intercept-and-Frame Kick Burst
raw.notes: As the partner advances, use a front kick to the pad, recoil and restore stance. If the partner keeps moving forward, establish a safe defensive frame and reset. Keep this to one linear kick family.

raw.name: Pressure-to-Clinch Transition
raw.notes: Enter behind two or three clean strikes, connect to balanced clinch position and settle before release. Stop if head position, stance or posture is lost.

raw.equipment_note: Partner uses Thai pads to present safe, changing close-range targets.
raw.name: Pocket Body-Head-Leg Intervals
raw.notes: The holder varies body, head, and leg target availability. Build compact 2-4 strike punch-kick exchanges, recoil each kick, and restore stance and guard between exchanges. Read the open target rather than repeating a fixed combination.

raw.equipment_note: The partner contests the connection moderately, then presents mitt targets only after clean separation.
raw.name: Control-Separate-Punch Intervals
raw.notes: Repeatedly establish brief arm or forearm control, separate into legal punching room, land one to three short punches to the mitts, then reconnect or reset in stance. The control problem must come before every return. Reduce output if the drill becomes static holding or free pocket trading.

raw.name: Anaconda Ambush
raw.notes: Sandbag simulates sprawl weight. (Explosive entries)

raw.name: Entry-Score-Exit Bursts
raw.notes: Explosive step-in, land 1-3 straight shots, then exit immediately at an angle. Full-quality reset before the next rep.

raw.name: Slip-Cross Burst
raw.notes: Holder shows a jab cue. Slip outside, fire one immediate cross counter, then step to safe range and reset. Stop the set if timing slows, defence gets loose or stance recovery deteriorates.

raw.duration: 3min rounds: combo → shot → sub attempt, 1min rest x 4
raw.name: Strike to Submission Chain
raw.notes: Simulates fight-ending sequences. (85% effort)

raw.name: Range Recovery Under Pressure
raw.notes: The partner briefly crowds from a safe live position. Use stance, frame, angle or a short intercept to leave before a wrestling connection settles. Regain open space before scoring again. Stop if posture, defence or level-change recognition breaks down.

raw.name: Cutoff-Reposition Intervals
raw.notes: Apply pressure, read the partner’s escape, reposition and attack again. Cut the route before throwing; stop and reset if the athlete chases or crosses the feet.

raw.equipment_note: Work at pocket range on a secured heavy bag without chasing its swing.
raw.name: Punch-Kick Exchange Intervals
raw.notes: Repeat separate 2-4 strike pocket exchanges using punches and a low or body kick. Recoil every kick, restore stance and guard, then begin the next exchange. No endless flurries; keep compact mechanics under fatigue.

raw.name: Pressure Escape and Reset
raw.notes: The partner applies controlled forward pressure. Escape with a short lateral or angled action, recover stance at usable range, score once, then reset. Do not rely on prolonged straight retreat. Reduce output if the escape no longer restores position.

raw.equipment_note: Partner wears Thai pads and gives controlled entries without extended clinch fighting.
raw.name: Counter Knee Matrix
raw.notes: Partner cues a controlled forward punch or close-range entry. Read it, cover or frame to stop the entry, make an immediate knee counter, recoil and place the leg back in stance, then recover stance, frame, guard and position before the next feed. This is an entry counter, not a prolonged clinch exchange.

raw.name: Clinch to Spin Drill
raw.notes: Partner resists initial clinch. (Fast pivots)

raw.equipment_note: Use Thai pads after a light, agreed tie-up. No live elbows.
raw.modality: brief clinch interruption and strike on break
raw.name: Clinch-Break Strike Burst
raw.notes: The partner establishes one controlled brief tie-up. Frame and create safe separation, fire a compact 2–3 strike combination on the break, then restore stance and base. Reset if the tie-up becomes prolonged hand fighting.

raw.name: Entry-Safe Low-Kick Burst
raw.notes: The partner varies range and posture. Throw one hard low kick only when stance is stable, the target is available and the partner is not entering deeply. Recoil to defensive stance. No safe window means no kick.

raw.name: Teep Range-Control Flow
raw.notes: Use the teep only from a measured range. Recover the kicking leg into stance before moving, then circle as the bag returns. Reset if the bag movement pulls the stance out of shape.

raw.name: Check-Hook Pivot Burst
raw.notes: Holder applies a controlled forward-pressure cue. Land a check-hook counter, pivot off the line, then reset at safe range. Reduce speed if the athlete crosses their feet or loses defensive shape.

raw.name: Ring Generalship Rounds
raw.notes: Score with 1-3 shots, then exit at an angle. Do not stay square and do not retreat straight back repeatedly.

raw.equipment_note: Partner provides positional resistance through a realistic frame or brief separation from Thai clinch.
raw.name: Frame-Reconnect Burst
raw.notes: Partner frames or creates brief separation. Maintain balance, work around the frame, reconnect, regain useful inside position and stabilise. Do not add a striking flurry.

raw.name: Entry-and-Score Burst
raw.notes: Enter explosively, land two to four clean punches, then make a technical exit and regain stance. End the rep if the athlete becomes square.

raw.name: Corner Trap Burst
raw.notes: Cut off the partner, hold a balanced trapping position and score two to four punches. Stop and reset if the feet cross or the stance becomes square.

raw.equipment_note: Use live partner resistance at a padded wall or cage simulation. No uncontrolled impact into the surface.
raw.name: Cage Position Intervals
raw.notes: Battle repeatedly for the pin, underhook and head position as the partner contests turns, reversals, escapes and re-pins. Preserve posture, balance, inside position and decision quality. Reduce resistance if the work becomes sloppy wrestling. The partner may show a controlled takedown threat, but the athlete must keep and recover standing control.

raw.name: Counter Quality Rounds
raw.notes: Holder repeats varied attack cues under a steady pace. Athlete defends or intercepts, counters accurately, then resets. Keep timing, accuracy and defensive shape intact; never chase uncontrolled punch volume.

raw.name: Submission to Sweep Chain
raw.notes: If sub fails, immediately chain to sweep. (Fast transitions)

raw.name: Jab Volume & Position
raw.notes: Maintain frequent jab output. Every jab or double jab must finish with balanced stance, defensive recovery and preferred range restored.

raw.name: Kick-Exit Intervals
raw.notes: Kick only from long range, recover stance, then exit laterally before resetting. Reduce output if recoil slows or feet cross.

raw.name: Takedown to Backtake Scramble
raw.notes: Partner counters takedown — you must immediately transition to back control. (90% explosiveness)

raw.name: Entry-Score-Angle Burst
raw.notes: Enter for one clean score and immediately take an angle before the partner can establish wrestling contact. Recover stance at safe range. Stop if the exit becomes upright or square.

raw.name: Granby to Single Leg
raw.notes: Partner provides light resistance. (Explosive)

raw.name: Range Movement Flow
raw.notes: Move economically in stance at preferred range. Every 10-15 seconds, score lightly, reposition off the return line and recover stance. Keep the pace low; reduce output if balance or foot position breaks down.

raw.name: Strike-Level-Change Decision Rounds
raw.notes: The partner mixes striking advances, genuine level changes and feints. Identify the threat before choosing range, angle, hip-back defence or a sprawl. Reset at preferred range. Reduce output if recognition becomes late.

raw.name: Explosive Cutoff Burst
raw.notes: Close the escape route fast, score a short shadow combination and reset fully. Do not cross the feet or chase straight behind the opponent.

raw.equipment_note: The partner wears mitts and varies realistic close-contact problems at a sustainable pace; punches land only on the mitts.
raw.name: Reactive Clinch Decision Rounds
raw.notes: The partner unpredictably ties one arm, squares chest-to-chest, presses inward, begins separating, exposes brief punching space, or smothers offence. Without a pre-called response, choose to frame, regain inside position, turn, smother, separate, or punch the mitts when legal space appears. Restore stance and guard after each exchange and lower resistance if decisions or balance deteriorate.

raw.name: Inverted Triangle Matrix
raw.notes: Use wall to control inversion angle. (Technical)

raw.name: Entry-Exit Burst
raw.notes: From preferred range, enter explosively, make one clean scoring action, then exit to safe range and recover stance. Use maximal speed. Stop and reset if balance, speed or position deteriorates.

raw.name: Rolling Backtake Drill
raw.notes: Partner starts in turtle. (Fast transitions)

raw.equipment_note: The holder controls contact and presents close-range targets.
raw.name: Cover-Return Burst
raw.notes: The holder gives one controlled short attack. Cover in a high guard, return 2-4 compact punches, then restore guard and stance. Fully reset; do not trade freely.

raw.name: Pressure Footwork Flow
raw.notes: Stalk at a controlled pace while keeping stance width and head position. Do not cross the feet or chase straight behind an imagined opponent; reset stance after every entry.

raw.name: Arm Drag to Backtake
raw.notes: Partner resists first 2 seconds. (Explosive pulls)

raw.name: Wall-Wrestler Pummel Rounds
raw.notes: Pummel for underhooks while pressed against wall. Simulates cage work.

raw.name: Clinch Fighter's Frame Endurance
raw.notes: Maintain frames against partner's forward pressure.

raw.name: Thai Plum Explosion Drill
raw.notes: Yank partner's neck down with full power from plum position.

raw.name: Blast Double Sprints
raw.notes: Sprint into explosive takedown finish.

raw.name: Hybrid Stance Switch Drill
raw.notes: Switch stances every 3 steps while navigating cones.

raw.equipment_note: Partner provides light, changing resistance in a Thai clinch position.
raw.name: Clinch Position Flow
raw.notes: From connection, gain useful inside arm and head position, keep posture, then recover and stabilise as the partner changes grips, angle and position with light resistance. No maximal pulling.

raw.name: Jab-Teep Control Rounds
raw.notes: Use jab and teep to halt or redirect the holder’s advance. Recover stance before moving and reset if preferred range is lost.

raw.name: Intercepting Straight Burst
raw.notes: Holder makes a clear forward-entry cue. Land an immediate straight stop-hit, exit off line, and reset. Use one full-quality response only; do not turn it into a combination sprint.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives realistic positional resistance; use Thai pads as listed for controlled knees.
raw.name: Turn-and-Knee Burst
raw.notes: Establish useful clinch position against resistance, turn and off-balance without throwing, land one controlled knee to Thai pads, then restore position.

raw.name: MMA Read & Counter Flow
raw.notes: Partner unpredictably feeds a controlled jab, rear straight, kick, forward entry or level-change cue. Athlete reads the threat, uses a suitable defence or interception, makes one light counter to the pads, then restores stance and range before the next feed. Keep the pace easy and reduce cue variety if the athlete starts guessing.

raw.name: Japanese Necktie Drill
raw.notes: Focus on hip alignment. (Technical)

raw.name: Ring Escape Flow
raw.notes: Partner gives forward or lateral pressure cues. Move, pivot or L-step, regain open space, then reset stance and range.

raw.name: Check-Return Burst
raw.notes: Read the kick cue, check, return immediately with a clean kick, then recover a balanced stance. Success means a clean kick return and stance recovery, not merely fast counter timing.

raw.equipment_note: Use wrestler mat for knee protection.
raw.name: Sprawl-to-Shot Sprints
raw.notes: Sprawl, then explode into double-leg shot. Full recovery between reps.

raw.name: Failed Shot Punish & Reset
raw.notes: Partner gives a controlled failed or defended takedown entry and presents pad targets. Athlete reads the failed entry, establishes safe position, delivers a one-to-three-strike counter, disengages, then restores stance and range before the next cue. Do not extend the exchange into grappling; lower feed density if defensive position fades.

raw.name: Flying Sub Scramble
raw.notes: Focus on landing in control. (Technical)

raw.name: Hip Slam Drill
raw.notes: Max-power hip toss from double-collar tie.

raw.equipment_note: Partner controls the feed and holds Thai pads at close range.
raw.name: Cover-Hook-Kick Burst
raw.notes: Partner gives one controlled short attack. Cover, answer with a compact hook and low or body kick, recoil the kick, then restore stance and guard. Fully reset; do not trade freely. Stop if stance recovery slows.

raw.name: Kick-Exit Anti-Entry Rounds
raw.notes: Kick the held target and recoil. The partner gives an immediate forward response; exit or reposition, then restore a kick-ready defensive stance. No punch combination is required. Reduce or stop output if recoil, balance, accuracy or entry response fades.

raw.equipment_note: Partner gives a controlled entry cue on a safe surface. Keep the exchange standing and reset once position is stable.
